_why: Marksmanship drives the same four repurposed baseline spells as Beast
Mastery, but through its normal shot rotation rather than through the pet.
The premade build already takes Piercing Shots and Rapid Killing -- which
reset Lacerating Shot and refresh Pack Hunting off Aimed, Steady and Chimera
-- but misses the two talents that close the loop, and takes the third at
half strength:
Improved Hunter's Mark 3/3  (T1.1) your damage on a marked target heals
your pet for 30%. Hunter's Mark stops being a
nicety and becomes mandatory upkeep, and it
is the only pet healing a Marksmanship hunter
has that does not cost a global to Mend Pet.
Lethal Instincts 2/2        (T2.0, was 1/2) Arcane, Chimera, Aimed and
Steady refresh Instinctive Fire and extend it
by 6 seconds. At 2/2 the normal rotation
holds the 20% ranged haste buff up
permanently; the rotation only has to start
it once.
Go for the Throat 2/2       (T0.0) ranged crits give the pet focus and a
high-threat bleed. The premade build takes 0.
Rapid Recuperation 1/2      the spare point.
Funded entirely by the 7-point Survival dip. Improved Tracking is damage
against tracked creature types, which is a raid-composition talent, and
Survival Instincts cannot be kept without it -- it sits in tier 1 and needs
5 points above it -- so the dip is all-or-nothing and it goes.
64 Marksmanship / 7 Beast Mastery.
